title: Listening Practice Test 19 – Corporate Events & Training
description: Đề luyện Listening theo cấu trúc đề thi TOEIC (IIG Việt Nam), rút gọn 26 câu: Part 1 (2) · Part 2 (6) · Part 3 (9, có hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý và biểu đồ) · Part 4 (9, có sơ đồ). Chủ đề: tiệc công ty, đào tạo nội bộ, hoạt động gắn kết.

groups.transcript:
(A) Guests are being served dinner.
(B) Some chairs are being stacked.
(C) Some tables have been set for a meal.
(D) A banner is being hung on a wall.

options.C: Some tables have been set for a meal.
options.D: A banner is being hung on a wall.

questions.explanation: Bàn tiệc đã được bày sẵn đĩa, ly và hoa → (C) 'set for a meal'. Không có người nên các câu bị động tiếp diễn (A), (B), (D) đều sai.

groups.transcript:
(A) Some people are walking along a sidewalk.
(B) Some people are waiting for a bus.
(C) A taxi is being washed.
(D) Some pedestrians are crossing the street.

options.A: Some people are walking along a sidewalk.
options.B: Some people are waiting for a bus.
options.D: Some pedestrians are crossing the street.

questions.explanation: Hai người đang đi bộ trên vỉa hè → (A). Không có trạm xe buýt (B); không ai rửa xe (C); họ không băng qua đường (D).

groups.transcript:
Where is the company picnic being held this year?
(A) Next Saturday.
(B) At Lakeside Park.
(C) It was a great picnic.

questions.explanation: Where → địa điểm: công viên Lakeside. (A) trả lời When; (C) lặp 'picnic' và sai thì.

groups.transcript:
Have you registered for the leadership workshop?
(A) The cash register is broken.
(B) It's a leadership position.
(C) Yes, I signed up yesterday.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No → 'Rồi, tôi đăng ký hôm qua' (sign up = register). (A) bẫy 'registered' – 'register' (máy tính tiền); (B) lặp 'leadership'.

groups.transcript:
Who's giving the welcome speech at the banquet?
(A) The CEO, Ms. Harlow.
(B) At the Grand Hotel.
(C) A three-course dinner.

questions.explanation: Who → người phát biểu. (B) trả lời Where; (C) liên tưởng 'banquet' – 'dinner'.

groups.transcript:
Could you order the name badges for the seminar?
(A) Sure. How many do we need?
(B) In alphabetical order.
(C) The seminar was useful.

options.A: Sure. How many do we need?

questions.explanation: Lời nhờ đặt thẻ tên → đồng ý và hỏi số lượng. (B) 'order' với nghĩa thứ tự; (C) lặp 'seminar'.

groups.transcript:
Why was the training session postponed?
(A) It's posted on the board.
(B) For two hours.
(C) The trainer's flight was canceled.

questions.explanation: Why → lý do: chuyến bay của giảng viên bị huỷ. (A) bẫy âm 'postponed' – 'posted'; (B) trả lời How long.

groups.transcript:
Should we have the party at the office or at a restaurant?
(A) Yes, it was a nice party.
(B) A restaurant would be more relaxing.
(C) I'll be at the office.

options.A: Yes, it was a nice party.
options.B: A restaurant would be more relaxing.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → chọn nhà hàng kèm lý do. (A) Yes không hợp, lặp 'party'; (C) lặp 'office'.

groups.transcript:
M: Hi, Lisa. I'm organizing the company's end-of-year party. Could you help me choose a caterer?
W: Sure. Last year we used Bella Catering, and everyone loved the food.
M: I called them this morning, but they're already booked on December twentieth.
W: That's too bad. Have you tried Green Table? They're a bit more expensive, but they specialize in vegetarian dishes, and a lot of our staff don't eat meat.
M: That's a good point. I'll call them this afternoon and ask for a menu.

questions.explanation: 'I'm organizing the company's end-of-year party.'

questions.content: What problem does the man mention?
questions.explanation: 'They're already booked on December twentieth' → công ty cung cấp tiệc Bella không nhận được.

questions.content: Why does the woman recommend Green Table?

options.B: It is close to the office.

questions.explanation: 'They specialize in vegetarian dishes, and a lot of our staff don't eat meat.' (A) sai: họ đắt hơn một chút.

groups.transcript:
W: Thanks for meeting with me, Victor and Ben. We need to plan the training for the twenty new sales representatives who start next month.
M1: Last year we did two full days of classroom training.
M2: Honestly, most people forgot everything by the end of the second day.
W: Yes, I heard that complaint, too.
M1: What if we split it into shorter sessions over two weeks? And the new staff could shadow experienced salespeople.
W: I like that. Ben, can you ask a few of our top sales reps if they'd be willing to be mentors?
M2: Sure. I'll send out an e-mail today.

options.C: A training program for new staff

questions.explanation: 'We need to plan the training for the twenty new sales representatives.'

questions.content: What does one of the men imply when he says, “most people forgot everything by the end of the second day”?

options.A: The previous training format was not effective.
options.D: The materials were difficult to find.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: học dồn hai ngày khiến học viên quên hết → cách đào tạo cũ không hiệu quả; vì vậy nhóm đề xuất chia nhỏ buổi học.
'Ben, can you ask a few of our top sales reps…?' – 'I'll send out an e-mail today.'

groups.transcript:
W: Hi, Tom. Are you coming to the team-building day on Saturday?
M: Yes, but I have a dentist appointment in the morning, so I won't get there until one thirty.
W: Oh, that's too bad. You'll miss the scavenger hunt and lunch.
M: I know. But I'm really looking forward to the next activity. I've always wanted to learn how to make fresh pasta.
W: Me too. By the way, don't forget to wear comfortable shoes. We'll be doing a lot of walking.
M: Thanks for the reminder.

questions.content: Why will the man arrive late?

options.C: He is picking up a relative.

questions.explanation: 'I have a dentist appointment in the morning.'

questions.content: Look at the graphic. Where will the man go first?
questions.explanation: Anh tới lúc 1:30, hoạt động kế tiếp là lớp nấu ăn lúc 2:00 (anh muốn học làm mì pasta) → Chef's Studio.

questions.content: What does the woman remind the man to do?
questions.explanation: 'Don't forget to wear comfortable shoes.'

groups.transcript: Good evening, and welcome to the Westfield Business Association's annual awards dinner. Before we present tonight's awards, I'm pleased to introduce our guest speaker, Dr. Samuel Osei. Dr. Osei is the founder of GreenPath, a company that has helped more than two hundred local businesses reduce their energy costs. His new book, Small Changes, Big Savings, was published last month. Copies will be available for purchase after dinner, and Dr. Osei has kindly agreed to sign them. Please join me in welcoming Dr. Osei.

questions.explanation: 'Welcome to the… annual awards dinner.'

questions.content: What has Dr. Osei's company done?
questions.explanation: '…has helped more than two hundred local businesses reduce their energy costs.'
'Copies will be available for purchase after dinner, and Dr. Osei has kindly agreed to sign them.' (B) diễn ra trước bài phát biểu.

groups.transcript: Welcome to today's workshop on our new project management software. Before we begin, please log in to the laptop in front of you, using the password on the card beside it. We'll start with the basics: creating a project and assigning tasks. Now, I know some of you have been using the old system for ten years. Don't worry. Most people get used to the new one within a week. We'll take a fifteen-minute break at ten thirty, and coffee will be available in the hallway.

questions.content: What is the topic of the workshop?
questions.explanation: '…today's workshop on our new project management software.'

questions.content: Where can listeners find a password?

options.D: On a card beside the laptop

questions.explanation: '…using the password on the card beside it.'

questions.content: Why does the speaker say, “I know some of you have been using the old system for ten years”?

options.B: To recognize that adjusting may be difficult
options.C: To ask for help teaching the class
options.D: To explain why the workshop is long

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi hàm ý: người dùng hệ thống cũ lâu năm có thể thấy khó thay đổi; anh trấn an ngay sau đó 'Don't worry…'.

groups.transcript: Good morning, and welcome to the Regional Managers' Retreat. Please note a change to today's schedule. The morning workshop will now be held in the room directly across from the registration area, because the projector in Ballroom A isn't working. Lunch will be served on the garden terrace at noon, weather permitting. Also, if you haven't picked up your welcome package yet, please see the staff at the registration desk.

questions.content: Why has the location of the workshop changed?
questions.explanation: '…because the projector in Ballroom A isn't working.'

questions.content: Look at the graphic. Where will the morning workshop be held?
questions.explanation: 'The room directly across from the registration area' – trên sơ đồ, đối diện Registration qua hành lang là Lounge.

questions.content: What should listeners do at the registration desk?
questions.explanation: 'If you haven't picked up your welcome package yet, please see the staff at the registration desk.'
